purpose: Create a finite response-blind candidate set from external biology before inspecting focal occurrence availability, fitted role answers, or cross-role outcomes.
candidate_discovery_queries_frozen: obligate pollination experimental dependence exact study site phenology
specialist larva obligate host field experiment exact site phenology
obligate brood-site mutualism exclusion experiment exact locality
host-dependent development experimental host specificity exact field site

G1_event_relation.rule: A primary external source must support the exact directional event implication being proposed; only supported directions are admitted.

G2_operational_space.rule: Published or independently frozen metadata must identify an exact or unambiguous relation population/site unit; country/island-wide presence is insufficient when the event is local.

G3_operational_time.rule: The biological event must have a prospectively defensible temporal key or window. General species phenology cannot silently substitute for the event-specific window.

G4_role_estimands.rule: Both role answers must measure the event-relevant estimands. Generic occurrence or habitat-suitability surfaces cannot be relabelled as reproduction, visitation, host use, or stage transition.

G5_focal_evidence_independence.rule: The data that define the external hard relation cannot also score the confirmatory focal endpoint. Independent or fresh role-answer sources must be identifiable from metadata before focal outcome access.

G6_management_and_intervention_scope.rule: Deliberate release, cultivation, experimental placement, or other management that creates the relation-space pattern must be absent or the candidate is engineering-only.

G7_fresh_endpoint_identity.rule: A previously consumed Product-B pair/outcome cannot be reopened or reclassified as a fresh endpoint. A genuinely new event estimand requires a distinct prospectively frozen endpoint identity.

candidate_registry_rule.candidate_hunting_hard_stop_rule: Stop external candidate discovery when either 3 candidates pass all G1-G7 gates or 12 candidates have been screened, whichever happens first.
candidate_registry_rule.after_hard_stop: Freeze the whole registry. Run any later source/sampling feasibility on all fully admitted candidates under one common predeclared feasibility contract. Do not add replacements because a candidate has sparse data.

candidate_ordering_rule.within_each_frozen_query: record qualifying primary-literature systems in search-result discovery order before reading any occurrence availability metadata
candidate_ordering_rule.duplicate_systems: retain the first discovery record and cross-reference later sources
candidate_ordering_rule.priority_after_admission: none; all fully admitted candidates enter source-feasibility together
